description:
Revoke an active or pending authorization. Only authorizations with status "active" or "pending" can be revoked.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: revoke_authorization

outputSchema.description: Authorization granting permission to send confirmations via a specific channel

denied_at.description: When the recipient refused — the mirror of `authorized_at` for a `denied` row (a challenger cancellation stamps it too). Absent unless the authorization was denied; before it existed such a row carried no decision time at all, only `updated_at`.

enrolled.description: Whether the approver has enrolled an encryption key. A confirmation can be sealed to an approver only once this is true; consent alone (`status: active`) is not enough.

label.description: Owner-assigned human label for this approver (F22); null when unset. Surfaces lead with it, falling back to the masked recipient.

proof_token.description: Signed proof of the recipient's decision, minted when they approved or refused, for both scopes. Absent while no decision has been made.

recipient.description: Channel-specific recipient identifier (chat_id for Telegram, phone or BSUID for WhatsApp)

recipient_display_name.description: The approver's own messenger name ("First Last @username"), captured when they approved over Telegram; null when none was captured. Chosen by the approver, not verified.

scope.description: Scope of the authorization. `identity_challenge` is the Proof of Me scope.
